segments.thi-ap22:7.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.thi-ap22:8.3: Kisāgotamī [gotamī nāma (sī. ka.)] nāmena, hessati satthu sāvikā’.
segments.thi-ap22:9.1: “Taṃ sutvā muditā hutvā, yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ;
segments.thi-ap22:11.3: Kassapo nāma gottena, uppajji vadataṃ varo.
segments.thi-ap22:14.1: “Anujāni na no tāto, agāreva tadā mayaṃ;
segments.thi-ap22:16.3: Dhammā ceva sudhammā ca, sattamī saṅghadāyikā.
segments.thi-ap22:17.3: Ahañca dhammadinnā ca, visākhā hoti sattamī.
segments.thi-ap22:19.1: “Pacchime ca bhave dāni, jātā seṭṭhikule ahaṃ;
segments.thi-ap22:19.3: Duggate adhane naṭṭhe [nīce (syā.), niddhe (pī.)], gatā ca sadhanaṃ kulaṃ.
segments.thi-ap22:20.1: “Patiṃ ṭhapetvā sesā me, dessanti adhanā iti;
segments.thi-ap22:20.3: Yadā ca pasūtā [sasutā (sī. pī.)] āsiṃ, sabbesaṃ dayitā tadā.
segments.thi-ap22:21.1: “Yadā so taruṇo bhaddo [putto (sī. syā.)], komalako [komārako (syā.), komalaṅgo (sī. pī.)] sukhedhito;
segments.thi-ap22:21.3: Sapāṇamiva kanto me, tadā yamavasaṃ gato.
segments.thi-ap22:24.1: “Na vijjante matā yasmiṃ, gehe siddhatthakaṃ tato;
segments.thi-ap22:25.1: “Tadā gamitvā sāvatthiṃ, na labhiṃ tādisaṃ gharaṃ;
segments.thi-ap22:25.3: Kuto siddhatthakaṃ tasmā, tato laddhā satiṃ ahaṃ.
segments.thi-ap22:28.1: “‘Na gāmadhammo nigamassa dhammo, na cāpiyaṃ ekakulassa dhammo;
segments.thi-ap22:28.3: Sabbassa lokassa sadevakassa, eseva dhammo yadidaṃ aniccatā’.
segments.thi-ap22:35.3: Ñāṇaṃ me vimalaṃ suddhaṃ, buddhaseṭṭhassa vāhasā.
segments.thi-ap22:36.3: Tato saṅghāṭikaṃ katvā, lūkhaṃ dhāremi cīvaraṃ.
segments.thi-ap22:39.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap22:41.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ kisāgotamī bhikkhunī imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
